d: Trump Backs Bukele in Haiti, the State Department Doesn’t. Who Decides US Policy? In this episode of The Link, Shubhangi Sharma breaks down the diplomatic clash between Washington and El Salvador, Bukele’s military operations against Haiti’s gangs, the role of Erik Prince’s Vectus Global, and whether Trump’s “Donroe Doctrine” now means outsourcing security in America’s backyard. Plus, why a century of foreign interventions, from US Marines in 1915 to UN peacekeepers and the Kenya-led mission, has never left Haiti with a working state.
